acceptance: RED first: a fixture change with a test that does not probe it counts that hunk as insensitive
A fixture change whose test fails without it counts as sensitive
The probe runs in a scratch worktree and never writes in the plane tree
The index starts at stage shadow
fix: For each production hunk of a ship commit: in a scratch worktree, revert only that hunk, run the tests that cover its lines (per-test coverage of the touched packages), and record sensitive when a test fails. A hunk that does not compile alone counts as sensitive and is reported. Exclude the kill paths of Q5.
